body.name: a-very-long-agent-name-for-test
body.display_name: An Exceptionally Long Display Name Used To Test Wrapping In Every Panel Of The U
body.role: Specialised documentation router for long and complicated requests from humans
body.description: Exists to test long text. It routes documentation requests that the main router hands over, and it writes very long one-lines so every panel can be checked for wrapping, truncation and overflow at phone and desktop widths in both light and dark mode.

one_line.text: Goal: keep every human request answered within one minute, every disk under seventy percent and every guide current for the newest release. Now: reading the live list, rating four candidates and writing a handover note for the specialised docs router bot.
